{{Quote|He doesn't look so tough. You don't look so tough to me!|The prisoner, commenting on Obi-Wan Kenobi, disguised as Rako Hardeen|<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>}}
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]]''' was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|This food tastes terrible. Maybe you'd taste better.|An undercover Obi-Wan Kenobi, disguised as Rako Hardeen, threatens the Karkarodon|<ref name="Deception" />}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]], along with another inmate, began to provoke a newcomer to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kenobi was undercover&mdash;disguised as a [[Sniper/Legends|marksman]] from [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]], [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] and claimed to have [[Death/Legends|killed]] Kenobi with a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|Sniper rifle]]&mdash;to learn of a plot to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] by befriending the plot creator, [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]]. After remarking that the Detention Center's [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] was detestable he then impaled the Karkarodon with a [[Fork/Legends|fork]] and suggested that he would taste better. The Karkarodon then fled, but in turn allowed Kenobi to meet Eval.

==Personality and traits==
The Karkarodon was a bully to newcomers in the prison. He wore an [[Color/Legends|orange]] prison jumpsuit with the number 335 emblazoned on the back.
